modes.name: modes
modes.description: The list of mode names to switch between (e.g. 'walk', 'orbit', 'dollhouse').

activeMode.name: activeMode
activeMode.description:
Index of the mode that is active on startup. Also tracks the current mode at runtime,
settling to the requested mode only once its transition completes.

activeSplat.name: activeSplat
activeSplat.description: Name of the splat to load on startup. Also tracks the currently loaded splat at runtime.

budget.name: budget
budget.description:
Override for the splat budget in millions of splats. When 0, the budget is chosen
automatically from the platform and the current quality mode.

gsplat.name: gsplat
gsplat.description: The entity carrying the gsplat component whose asset this manager swaps.

eyeHeight.name: eyeHeight
eyeHeight.description: Eye height above the floor in metres.

cameraEntity.name: cameraEntity
cameraEntity.description: The shared camera entity carrying the `cameraBridge` script.

poseMarker.name: poseMarker
poseMarker.description:
Optional pose marker — its transform sets the standing position + look
direction on entry. Falls back to this script's own entity.

collisionAsset.name: collisionAsset
collisionAsset.description:
Collision data for ground + walls: a `.glb` (mesh) or voxel `.json`.
Walk mode needs this — without it the camera has no ground to stand on.

camera.name: camera
camera.description:
Camera settings applied on walk entry. NOTE: fields added to this group after a scene
is serialized are clobbered by the editor's group applier — re-save the script's
attributes in the editor when extending it.

schema.name: fov
schema.description: Field of view in degrees.

schema.name: clearColor
schema.description: Camera clear color while in walk mode (the interior background).

schema.name: sharpness
schema.description: CameraFrame sharpness (0..1) while in walk mode.

schema.name: animAsset
schema.description:
Intro / idle camera animation track (e.g. anim/orbit.json). When set, dollhouse plays it on
the first entry; after a pointer/wheel interrupt hands control to orbit, going idle eases the
camera back onto the nearest point of the track and resumes playback.

schema.name: idleReturnDelay
schema.description: Seconds of no interaction before the camera eases back into the animation.

schema.name: orbitBox
schema.description:
Soft-box envelope the dollhouse camera orbits — an entity whose world transform (position,
rotation, scale) is the box roughly enclosing the church. The camera rides at a standoff
outside it and the focus tracks its surface, so framing hugs the building from every angle.
If unset, the dollhouse falls back to the generic orbit controller.

schema.name: cornerRadius
schema.description: Corner rounding of the orbit envelope in world units (softens the path around box edges).

schema.name: standoffMin
schema.description: Closest the camera may zoom to the envelope surface, in world units.

schema.name: standoffMax
schema.description: Farthest the camera may zoom from the envelope surface, in world units.

schema.name: elevationMin
schema.description:
Lowest camera elevation in degrees (0 = level with the walls; negative dips below). Kept
small/negative so the camera stays above the floor.

schema.name: elevationMax
schema.description:
Highest camera elevation in degrees as it tilts up toward a centred top view. Kept below 90
so it never reaches a straight-down spin.

schema.name: orbitInertia
schema.description:
Orbit glide time in seconds: how long a drag's momentum coasts after release (and how long a
drag takes to ease in). ~0.15 feels tight, ~0.8 floaty.

schema.name: orbitSmoothing
schema.description: Orbit follow lag in seconds: how softly the camera eases toward the dragged target.

schema.name: orbitSensitivity
schema.description:
Orbit drag sensitivity — how fast the camera slides along the envelope per drag. Input is
normalized so all faces move at a uniform rate; this scales that rate (1 = default).

schema.name: triggers
schema.description:
Trigger entities driving the cutouts. Each entry's world transform (position, rotation,
scale) is a unit trigger box: while the camera is inside it, its cutout opens. The entry's
DIRECT CHILDREN are the cutout boxes — each child's world transform is a unit box carved
out of the splat, alpha-fading with its trigger's blend weight while a soft glowing rim
hugs the cut edge. One trigger can drive any number of boxes (16 total across all
triggers).

schema.name: edgeWidth
schema.description:
Thickness of the glowing rim in SCREEN PIXELS — scaled to world units per-fragment so the
rim keeps a constant on-screen size regardless of the cut's distance from the camera.

schema.name: edgeColor
schema.description: Colour of the glowing cut edge.

schema.name: edgeIntensity
schema.description: Brightness multiplier for the edge glow (values > 1 push it into HDR so bloom catches it).

schema.name: blendDamping
schema.description:
Smoothing of the cutout's alpha blend toward its on/off target as the camera enters or leaves
a trigger box. The remaining gap closes by a factor of `blendDamping` every
millisecond, so higher = slower (frame-rate independent): ~0.95 ≈ 0.1s, ~0.995 ≈ 1s,
~0.997 ≈ 1.5s, ~0.998 ≈ 2.3s to reach the target.

schema.name: splatMargin
schema.description:
World-units half-width of the border band around each cutout surface. Splats deeper inside
a box than this fade at the per-splat stage; splats within it run the pixel-exact fragment
test. Must conservatively cover the largest splat radius plus the rim's world width at
typical viewing distance — too small pops splats at the cut, too large just costs a little
fragment work.

cameraEntity.name: cameraEntity
cameraEntity.description: The shared camera entity carrying the `cameraBridge` script.

camera.name: camera
camera.description:
Camera settings applied on dollhouse entry. NOTE: fields added to this group after a
scene is serialized are clobbered by the editor's group applier — re-save the script's
attributes in the editor when extending it.

schema.name: fov
schema.description: Field of view in degrees.

schema.name: clearColor
schema.description: Camera clear color while in dollhouse mode (the exterior background).

schema.name: sharpness
schema.description: CameraFrame sharpness (0..1) while in dollhouse mode.

schema.name: box
schema.description:
Box entity enclosing the flag cloth (a unit box placed/scaled to hug it). Assumed
WORLD-AXIS-ALIGNED — the entity's rotation is ignored (keeps the per-splat test to a
subtract and compare). Convention: the pole edge is the box's +X face, the cloth extends
toward -X, and the flap displaces along world ±Z. Unset (or amplitude 0) disables the
effect.

schema.name: amplitude
schema.description:
Peak flap displacement at the flag's free edge, in world units. Keep small relative to the
cloth — splat sorting uses the undisplaced centers, so a large billow would sort wrongly.

schema.name: wavelength
schema.description: Wavelength of the travelling wave in world units.

schema.name: speed
schema.description: Wave travel speed in cycles per second.

schema.name: maxDistance
schema.description:
Camera distance to the box centre (world units) beyond which the flap is disabled. Past
this range the motion is sub-pixel anyway, but it would still cost every splat the box
test and keep on-demand rendering from ever idling — the frustum gates it the same way
when the flag is off-screen.

gamingControls.name: gamingControls
gamingControls.description: Desktop "gaming" controls (look without holding a button, etc.).

cameraEntity.name: cameraEntity
cameraEntity.description: The shared camera entity carrying the `cameraBridge` script.

schema.name: texture2
schema.description:
Optional secondary LUT texture. When set, both LUTs are sampled and the two graded
results are crossfaded according to.

schema.name: blend
schema.description:
Crossfade between the two graded results. 0 shows only the primary LUT, 1 shows only the
secondary LUT, intermediate values produce a linear-space mix.

annotationsAsset.name: annotationsAsset
annotationsAsset.description:
Annotations JSON: { version, walk:{ annotations:[…] }, dollhouse:{ annotations:[…] } }.
Each annotation: { position:[x,y,z], title, text(HTML), camera:{ initial:{ position, target, fov } } }.

cameraEntity.name: cameraEntity
cameraEntity.description:
The rendering camera entity (must carry CameraBridge). Defaults to the first camera in the
scene if unset.

insideWaypoints.name: insideWaypoints
insideWaypoints.description:
Parent entity for the INSIDE (walk) waypoint graph: its children are the nodes, and its
`waypoints` script holds the edge pairs. Optional — without it, walk flights go direct.

outsideWaypoints.name: outsideWaypoints
outsideWaypoints.description: Parent entity for the OUTSIDE (dollhouse) waypoint graph. Optional.

outsideObstacle.name: outsideObstacle
outsideObstacle.description:
Obstacle envelope for OUTSIDE flight clearance — assign the same box entity the dollhouse
envelope uses (envelope.orbitBox). When set, outside flights go direct whenever the straight
path clears the box, endpoints attach to any waypoint with a clear segment (not just the
nearest), and the waypoints auto-connect with every chord that clears — so a bare ring of
locators routes well without hand-authored edges. Optional: without it, outside routing
falls back to nearest-node attach over the authored edges.

edges.title: Edges
edges.description: Each row connects two child waypoint entities (undirected).

heightLow.name: heightLow
heightLow.description: Camera height (world Y) at/below which the city blend is fully the LOW loop.

heightHigh.name: heightHigh
heightHigh.description: Camera height at/above which the city blend is fully the HIGH loop.

fadeTime.name: fadeTime
fadeTime.description: Inside/outside soundscape crossfade time in seconds on a mode switch.

walkFadeTime.name: walkFadeTime
walkFadeTime.description: Walk-loop fade time in seconds when starting/stopping movement.

walkSpeedThreshold.name: walkSpeedThreshold
walkSpeedThreshold.description: Horizontal speed (m/s) above which the camera counts as walking.

cameraEntity.name: cameraEntity
cameraEntity.description:
The rendering camera entity (carries the cameraBridge; used for height/speed and the
walk-mode check).

cityLow.name: cityLow
cityLow.description: City loop heard near the ground (Sound component, slot Loop + Auto Play).

walk.name: walk
walk.description: Walking/footsteps loop (typically on the camera entity itself).

carA.name: carA
carA.description: The first car. Its initial position defines one end of the route.

carB.name: carB
carB.description: The second car. Its initial position defines the other end of the route.

duration.name: duration
duration.description: Time in seconds for one leg of the route (point to point).

carC.name: carC
carC.description: The third car. Its initial position defines the other end of the route.

texture.name: texture
texture.description:
The equirectangular skybox texture (RGBP-encoded HDR panorama). Assigned to
`scene.envAtlas` once loaded.

material.name: material
material.description: The material asset to force into depth-only mode.
